_comment: UMBRELLA PROJECTS ONLY (provisioned when a project's mode is 'umbrella' in config/teams.yml). {{GROUP_BY_ATTRIBUTE}} is substituted from that project's 'group_by_attribute' (e.g. 'team'). Requires teams to additionally report (or copy) launches into this project tagged per dashboard-kit/ci-examples/ATTRIBUTES.md. CONFIRMED against a live RP 5.15.x instance: 'componentHealthCheck' requires widgetOptions.attributeKeys (an ARRAY), widgetOptions.minPassingRate (string percentage), and widgetOptions.excludeSkipped (string 'true'/'false') -- see team_project_comparison.json for details. 'statisticTrend' with 4 contentFields (incl. skipped) + widgetOptions.timeline='launch' is confirmed working.

widgets.name: Team Health Overview
widgets.description: Cross-team pass/fail comparison, grouped by the '{{GROUP_BY_ATTRIBUTE}}' launch attribute.

widgets.name: Cross-Team Trend
widgets.description: Aggregate pass/fail trend across all teams reporting into this umbrella project.
